items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: playing the Savoy Ballroom in Chicago in the thirties and Chick Webb, along with Ella Fitzgerald, the great Ella Fitzgerald, during the years 'A Tisket, A Tasket' was a popular tune.

ctx.x: Getting the thing over to -- and here's another guy in my band that I had. Unfortunately, he died young. His name was Alvin Burroughs. We called him Mouse. Tom, he was one of the greatest drummers. In fact, I

had the pleasure of playing the Savoy Ballroom in Chicago in the thirties and Chick Webb, along with Ella Fitzgerald, the great Ella Fitzgerald, during the years 'A Tisket, A Tasket' was a popular tune.
